# ghost/reckoning-skills

Reckoning Skills (Privacy Friendly Apps, F-Droid): a mental arithmetic trainer with +, -, x and / problems, an on-screen keypad, a timer and a result list. Offline, no account.

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/reckoning-skills
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/reckoning-skills open_menu --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/reckoning-skills new_game --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/reckoning-skills get_problem --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/reckoning-skills answer --device <serial> --param value=<value>
ghost skill run ghost/reckoning-skills answer_many --device <serial> --param values=<values>
ghost skill run ghost/reckoning-skills get_result --device <serial>
```

## Actions

- `open_menu`: Open the Reckoning Skills app
- `new_game`: Start a new mental arithmetic game
- `get_problem`: What is the current arithmetic problem?
- `answer`: Answer the arithmetic problem with 7
- `answer_many`: Answer the next three problems with 2, 5 and 8
- `get_result`: How did I do in the arithmetic game?
